description: This file contains utility functions for grouping and filtering Card objects based on properties, used in a board or Kanban-style interface.

methods.name: groupCardsByOptions
methods.description: Groups cards based on provided option IDs and a grouping property.

methods.name: getOptionGroups
methods.description: Separates cards into visible and hidden groups based on option IDs and grouping property.

methods.name: getVisibleAndHiddenGroups
methods.description: Main exported function that returns visible and hidden groups, handling special 'createdBy', 'updatedBy', or 'person' group types.

methods.name: getPersonGroups
methods.description: Creates groups based on person-related properties such as creator or modifier.
